[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:383YE Autumn]]
__NOTOC__
<ic>To disburse senate funds intended for the purpose of constructing the Blackfield Market in Mitwold. 

Will create the title of Blackfield Bailiff to oversee the market, appointed annually through the Imperial Bourse by vote of the farm owners of the Marches.<br>
''Proposed by Bregasland, seconded by Mitwold.''</ic>
==Outcome==
* Motion to take advantage of the [[Great_prosperity_and_strength#Blackfield_Market|recent proposal]] to construct a [[ministry]] to purchase [[white granite]]
* Failed
==Date==
* Autumn 383YE
